findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/runtime-owned-agent-assets-smoke.ts:6-16 claims the runtime-owned agent asset path already treats requirementsDir as a project fact and exposes existing requirementsDir config coverage, but this smoke only exercises prompt-registry asset resolution and Non-authority boundaries. The implementation in packages/main/src/core/agent-asset-resolution.ts:48-50,203-220 inspects .claude/agents and .lattice-codex/agents and never reads or asserts requirementsDir, so the annotation overstates the implemented coverage and can act as a false gap_analyze anchor.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 31682c489e0951f687e170f9a8bd5da619de397e: removed the false requirementsDir claim from runtime-owned-agent-assets-smoke.ts and added a truthful requirementsDir anchor to truth.ts where scanTruth/generateNav consume loadConfig(projectRoot).requirementsDir. Verified npm build, runtime-owned-agent-assets smoke, gap-analyze-input-hygiene smoke, and lattice gap_analyze 0 high/0 medium.
